## Description
This is a test issue for verifying GitHub functionality in the repository.

## Context
Provide context about what is being tested (workflows, templates, configurations, etc.).

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to the repository
2. Open the Issues tab
3. Review this test issue

## Expected Outcome
- The issue should display correctly
- Automated workflows or templates should trigger as expected

## Additional Notes
- No further action is required unless specified for testing purposes
- This issue can be safely closed after testing is complete
